apps.localizedDescription:
### Total Factor — Adaptive Nutrition & Smart Strength Tracker

Total Factor is an offline-first, native iOS fitness powerhouse combining an **evidence-based adaptive nutrition coach** with a **MacroFactor-inspired smart gym tracker**.

Built entirely in modern SwiftUI and SwiftData, Total Factor runs completely on-device with zero subscription fees, zero cloud locks, and zero advertisements.

---

#### ⚡ Adaptive Energy Expenditure (TDEE)
- **True Metabolic Trend Engine**: Dynamically calculates your real Total Daily Energy Expenditure from your daily calorie intake and weight trend without relying on inaccurate smartwatch burn estimates.
- **Adherence-Neutral Weekly Check-Ins**: Guided coaching reviews adjust your macro targets automatically whether you ate over or under target—no guilt, no penalties.
- **Adaptive Rate of Loss / Gain**: Intelligently scales weekly caloric targets to maintain your chosen rate of body change.

#### 🥗 Frictionless Food Logging & The Plate
- **The Plate Multi-Add Dock**: Stage multiple food items, barcode scans, custom recipes, and quick adds into a unified bottom tray before committing—reducing logging time by 75%.
- **Hour-by-Hour Nutrition Timeline**: View your food intake organized by hour with macro distribution charts and adherence rings.
- **Zero-Scale Hand & Container Estimators**: Visual palm, fist, cupped hand, and thumb estimators plus standard takeout containers (deli pints, quarts, foil tins) for real-world dining.
- **Street & Cultural Food Library**: Pre-configured composite foods with piece-count steppers for foods you cannot weigh raw (street tacos, samosas, momos, sushi rolls, biryani bowls).
- **3-Second Ballpark Logger**: Rapid 1-tap logging for social dining, weddings, and buffets.
- **Offline Voice & Vision Describe**: Speak meals naturally or take a photo; on-device Apple Intelligence parses foods into grams and macros.

#### 🏋️ Smart Strength Tracker
- **MacroFactor-Style Workout UI**: Dedicated gym interface with custom numeric keypad, instantaneous RIR selection, and automatic set completion.
- **Rest Timer & Live Activities**: Interactive rest timers with Lock Screen, Dynamic Island, and Apple Watch notifications.
- **Muscle Hypertrophy Target Zones**: Tracks weekly direct volume sets per muscle group to ensure optimal stimulus and avoid overtraining.
- **Built-in Exercise Library**: 120+ strength movements with animated target diagrams, form cues, and historical PR tracking.

#### 🔒 Complete Privacy & Data Ownership
- **100% On-Device**: All data stored locally in SwiftData. Works completely offline without internet or cellular reception.
- **Two-Way Apple Health Sync**: Bidirectional sync for dietary calories, protein, carbs, fat, workouts, and scale weight.
- **Universal Data Export**: 1-tap export in Settings provides complete CSV packages, structured JSON, and a pre-formatted Markdown AI coaching digest for ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini.
